title: Italian Taro Fritters
description: A classic Italian-inspired fritter recipe using taro and a hint of zanzibari for added flavor. Perfect as a side dish or snack.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C (350°F).
Grate the taro and set aside.
In a bowl, combine grated taro, cooked pilaf, beaten egg, and dried zanzibari. Season with salt to taste.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the taro mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain excess oil on paper towels.
